Someone thus has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 29 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 29 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3128 identities would post 4562 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
